answer: Because the trellis count is verified against the prism text itself, the falcon audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 3 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Filling 87 aliases thus means producing 87 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. That is 19 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
